name: Freiburg im Breisgau
author: pierreggt
description: Map of Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany, from the city center to the surrounding Baden-Württemberg towns (Emmendingen, Bad Krozingen, Waldkirch, Müllheim, and others). Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022). Real German labor-market statistics (official employment counts and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows) anchor 7 of the 8 surrounding satellite municipalities; Freiburg city itself relies on a POI-density gravity model.
data_source: Zensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online) for satellite towns, gravity model for Freiburg itself, OSM, Overture Maps
